name: clip2
description: Non-cooking clip: planting pepper seedlings through holes in weed membrane, with pointing. One Pexels clip, ElevenLabs narration placed at the moments the actions happen.

lines.text: Right, poke a hole right here first.

expected.referent: the hole in the black membrane under the fingertip
pressing the soil around the seedling with the fingertips

lines.text: I'm planting pepper seedlings through weed membrane today.
Same again. Push your finger in there.

expected.referent: the next hole in the membrane
pressing the soil on both sides of the seedling with two fingers

lines.text: You want it standing up like this.

expected.referent: the seedling standing upright in firmed soil in its hole

lines.text: That's all there is to it.
